assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is ordered
The study is intended to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias
The CPT code 93226 corresponds to the Holter monitoring study
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The appeal is for CPT code 93226
